mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER () as rowCount , A.* FROM ( SELECT ANNVRSRY_ID as annId , USER_ID as usid , ANNVRSRY_SE as annvrsrySe , ANNVRSRY_NM as annvrsryNm , ANNVRSRY as annvrsryDe , CLDR_SE as cldrSe , ANNVRSRY_NTCN_SETUP as annvrsrySetup , ANNVRSRY_NTCN_BGNDE as annvrsryBeginDe , MEMO as memo , REPTIT_AT as reptitSe , FRST_REGISTER_ID as frstRegisterId , FRST_REGIST_PNTTM as FRST_REGISTER_PNTTM , LAST_UPDUSR_ID as lastUpdusrId , LAST_UPDT_PNTTM as lastUpdusrPnttm FROM NANNVRSRYMANAGE A WHERE 1=1 AND REPTIT_AT IS NULL AND ANNVRSRY like CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') AND USER_ID = #{usid} union all SELECT ANNVRSRY_ID as annId , USER_ID as usid , ANNVRSRY_SE as annvrsrySe , ANNVRSRY_NM as annvrsryNm , ANNVRSRY as annvrsryDe , CLDR_SE as cldrSe , ANNVRSRY_NTCN_SETUP as annvrsrySetup , ANNVRSRY_NTCN_BGNDE as annvrsryBeginDe , MEMO as memo , REPTIT_AT as reptitSe , FRST_REGISTER_ID as frstRegisterId , FRST_REGIST_PNTTM as FRST_REGISTER_PNTTM , LAST_UPDUSR_ID as lastUpdusrId , LAST_UPDT_PNTTM as lastUpdusrPnttm FROM NANNVRSRYMANAGE A WHERE 1=1 AND REPTIT_AT = '1' AND USER_ID = #{usid}) A ORDER BY A.annvrsryDe DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

SELECT COUNT(*) totcnt FROM ( SELECT * FROM NANNVRSRYMANAGE WHERE 1=1 AND REPTIT_AT IS NULL AND ANNVRSRY like CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') AND USER_ID = #{usid} union all SELECT * FROM NANNVRSRYMANAGE WHERE 1=1 AND REPTIT_AT = '1' AND USER_ID = #{usid} ) a

SELECT ANNVRSRY_ID as annId , ans.USER_ID as usid , ANNVRSRY_SE as annvrsrySe , ANNVRSRY_NM as annvrsryNm , ANNVRSRY as annvrsryDe , CLDR_SE as cldrSe , ANNVRSRY_NTCN_SETUP as annvrsrySetup , ANNVRSRY_NTCN_BGNDE as annvrsryBeginDe, MEMO as memo , FRST_REGISTER_ID as frstRegisterId, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM as FRST_REGISTER_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID as lastUpdusrId , LAST_UPDT_PNTTM as lastUpdusrPnttm, REPTIT_AT as reptitSe, mst.user_nm AS annvrsryTemp1, (select info.ORGNZT_NM from NORGNZTINFO info where info.ORGNZT_ID = mst.ORGNZT_ID ) AS annvrsryTemp2, (select code_nm from CCMMNDETAILCODE where code_id ='COM069' and code = ans.ANNVRSRY_SE) as annvrsryTemp3 FROM NANNVRSRYMANAGE ans, COMVNUSERMASTER mst WHERE ans.USER_ID = mst.esntl_id AND ans.ANNVRSRY_ID = #{annId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NANNVRSRYMANAGE (ANNVRSRY_ID , USER_ID , ANNVRSRY_SE , ANNVRSRY_NM , ANNVRSRY , CLDR_SE , ANNVRSRY_NTCN_SETUP, ANNVRSRY_NTCN_BGNDE , MEMO , REPTIT_AT , FRST_REGISTER_ID , FRST_REGIST_PNTTM) VALUES (#{annId}, #{usid} , #{annvrsrySe}, #{annvrsryNm}, #{annvrsryDe}, #{cldrSe}, #{annvrsrySetup}, #{annvrsryBeginDe}, #{memo}, #{reptitSe}, #{frstRegisterId}, now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE NANNVRSRYMANAGE SET ANNVRSRY_SE = #{annvrsrySe} , ANNVRSRY_NM = #{annvrsryNm} , ANNVRSRY = #{annvrsryDe} , CLDR_SE = #{cldrSe} , ANNVRSRY_NTCN_SETUP = #{annvrsrySetup} , ANNVRSRY_NTCN_BGNDE = #{annvrsryBeginDe} , MEMO = #{memo} , REPTIT_AT = #{reptitSe} , LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{lastUpdusrId} , LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = now() WHERE ANNVRSRY_ID = #{annId}
mapper.select: SELECT ANNVRSRY_ID as annId , USER_ID as usid , ANNVRSRY_SE as annvrsrySe , ANNVRSRY_NM as annvrsryNm , ANNVRSRY as annvrsryDe , ANNVRSRY_NTCN_BGNDE as annvrsryBeginDe, CLDR_SE as cldrSe , REPTIT_AT as reptitSe FROM NANNVRSRYMANAGE ans where USER_ID = #{usid}
